about.title: About me
about.lede: Konstantinos Fessaras - massage therapist, Mastichari, Kos.
bio: I have worked professionally with massage since 2011. I trained in relaxing, therapeutic and sports massage, then went on to Indian head massage, aromatherapy and Thai oil massage, and took separate seminars on sciatica, upper back pain and lower back pain.
I work on my own. There is no reception, no queue and no upselling: it is me, a professional massage table, and the hour you have booked, at my own place in the centre of Mastichari.

Most of my work is with visitors staying in Mastichari, Tigaki and Marmari, and plenty of guests come from further afield across the island too. My own place is in the pedestrian centre of Mastichari, right by the family souvenir shop Ghitonia - if I am not there, the family can tell you where I am, or you can simply call.
about.languagesBody: I speak Greek, English, Italian, French, German and a little bit of Russian. This website is offered in a few more languages than that so you can read about the massages in your own, but the conversation on the day will be in one of those six.

services.title: Massages
services.lede: Eight treatments, all with a professional table at my studio in Mastichari.
services.mixNote: Every body is different, so the massage differs too. It's usually a mix of relaxing, Swedish, therapeutic, sports, deep tissue massage and Thai massage. It runs from 30 to 90 minutes.
services.pricingBody: Prices are given when you get in touch. That way you always hear the current rate rather than a number left over from an old web page.
services.chooseHelp: Not sure which one? Say what hurts, or what your week has been like, and I will suggest one when you message.

full-body-massage.name: Full body massage
full-body-massage.short: The whole body worked through in sequence - back, neck, shoulders, arms, legs, feet and hands.
full-body-massage.lede: A full body massage means exactly that: the therapist works the whole body over the session rather than one region. Back, neck, shoulders, arms, legs, feet and hands.
body: This is the massage most people book first, and the one that suits a holiday best. Worked over the full 90 minutes it stops being a quick loosening-up and becomes a proper reset - there is time to spend on the areas that actually need it instead of rushing through everything.
I work with oil, at a pressure we agree on, and I check in as I go. You keep underwear on and stay covered with a towel apart from the area being worked on.
goodFor: General stiffness after travelling or long days on your feet
Tight, tired muscles that no single area explains
Improving how easily you move after a period of sitting
Getting circulation going again in legs and arms
Sleeping properly on the first nights of a holiday
Simply having an unhurried hour to yourself
full-body-massage.imageAlt: A massage table made up with fresh linen and a rolled towel, ready for a full body session.

relaxing-massage.name: Relaxing massage
relaxing-massage.short: The classic massage. Slow, even work over the whole body, aimed at letting go rather than at a specific problem.
relaxing-massage.lede: The relaxing massage - often called classic massage - is the most familiar type there is, and the best place to start if you have never had a massage before.
body: The aim is straightforward: relax the whole body. It combines gliding, kneading and cross-fibre friction to work through the knots that build up in muscle, but at a slower and more even pace than a therapeutic session.
If you are unsure what to book, this is usually the right answer. Nothing about it is intense and there is no part of it that should hurt.
goodFor: A first massage, if you have never had one
Stiff, aching joints and general soreness
Recovering after harder-than-usual exercise
Winding down when you have been running on stress
Getting circulation moving after a long flight
Concentration that has gone flat
Tiredness that sleep alone has not fixed
relaxing-massage.imageAlt: A quiet treatment corner with soft daylight, folded towels and a bottle of oil on a wooden stool.

therapeutic-sports-massage.name: Therapeutic and sports massage
therapeutic-sports-massage.short: Firmer, more targeted work for a specific complaint - a sports injury, a chronic ache, a movement that has become restricted.
therapeutic-sports-massage.lede: Therapeutic and sports massage is for a specific problem: an injury, a chronic ache, or a range of motion that has narrowed. It is the massage to ask for when something particular is wrong.
body: It suits people with sports injuries, long-standing pain, or the accumulated wear of physical work. It is also what I use for the complaints I took extra seminars in - sciatica, upper back pain and lower back pain.
The work is firmer and more localised than a relaxing massage. We agree the pressure before I start, and you tell me during the session if it needs to change. Firm should not mean painful.
goodFor: Soft tissue strains and older sports injuries
Long-standing back, neck and shoulder pain
A range of movement that has become restricted
Muscular pain from physical or repetitive work
Tension headaches that start in the neck
Recovery between training days
Sciatica, upper back and lower back complaints
therapeutic-sports-massage.imageAlt: Hands working through the muscle of a towel-draped calf on a massage table.

frozen-shoulder-treatment.name: Frozen shoulder therapeutic massage
frozen-shoulder-treatment.short: Gentle, gradual work on a stiff or painful shoulder, upper back and neck, within a comfortable range of movement.
frozen-shoulder-treatment.lede: Frozen shoulder treatment is gentle, gradual work on the shoulder, upper back and neck muscles, aimed at comfort rather than force.
body: We agree the pressure before I start, and I stay within a comfortable range of movement throughout - nothing is pushed or forced. Frozen shoulder should be diagnosed by a doctor first, and this session is not a substitute for that: it does not cure it, restore movement or shorten recovery. It is gentle, hands-on work on the muscles around a stiff or painful shoulder.
If you have been told you have frozen shoulder, or think you might, tell me when you book so I know what to expect and what to avoid.
goodFor: A stiff, aching shoulder you are already having looked at by a doctor
Tension that has spread from the shoulder into the upper back and neck
Gentle, careful work rather than deep pressure
A complement to physiotherapy you are already having
Simply wanting the area worked on with extra care
frozen-shoulder-treatment.imageAlt: A close-up of both hands working gently across a client's shoulder and upper back.

antistress-back-massage.name: Anti-stress back massage
antistress-back-massage.short: The back alone, worked from the lower spine up to the neck. The most straightforwardly enjoyable thing on the list.
antistress-back-massage.lede: For most people the back is the best part of the body to have massaged, and this is the massage that does nothing else. It runs from the lower spine up to the neck.
body: It calms you down and takes the edge off the week. People get off the table looking like they have been on holiday for three days rather than one afternoon. It suits every age.
It is the obvious present for anyone who works at a desk or sits in front of a screen for hours. If you only have half an hour and want the most noticeable result from it, book this.
goodFor: Tension held in the shoulders and upper back
Desk work, driving, long hours in a chair
Stress that has settled between the shoulder blades
Sleeping better
Tired, overworked back muscles
Headaches that come from a tight neck
antistress-back-massage.imageAlt: A massage table with a face cradle and a folded towel, seen from above in warm afternoon light.

indian-head-massage.name: Indian head massage
indian-head-massage.short: Pressure work on the neck, shoulders, scalp and face, adapted from Ayurvedic technique. Done seated, clothes on.
indian-head-massage.lede: Indian head massage is adapted from Ayurvedic technique and works the shoulders, neck, scalp and face through a series of pressure points. It is done seated and you stay dressed.
body: It is a good choice if you carry your tension high - in the jaw, the base of the skull, the shoulders - or if a full body massage is more than you want. It is also the one people book at the end of a long travel day, because it takes very little setting up.
I completed a dedicated seminar in this technique in 2014, held under the auspices of the World Massage Federation.
goodFor: Tension in the neck, shoulders and scalp
Headaches that build over a working day
Jaw tightness
Feeling wound up and unable to settle
Concentration and clarity going after a long day
Restlessness and trouble falling asleep
A short treatment when there is no time for a long one
indian-head-massage.imageAlt: A simple wooden chair with a folded towel over the back, set up by an open window for a seated head massage.

foot-massage.name: Foot massage
foot-massage.short: Reflex work on the feet - the oldest trick there is for a body that has been standing all day.
foot-massage.lede: The nerves of the body gather at the feet, which is why a foot massage is felt well beyond the feet themselves. The Chinese refined the practice of foot reflexology over centuries.
body: Regular foot massage feels good and gets the circulation moving, and it is the fastest way to take the day out of a body that has been walking on hot stone and sand since morning.
It is a good option on a hot afternoon, when a full oil massage is more than you want, and a good one for anyone who spends the working year on their feet.
goodFor: Feet and legs that have been walking all day
Swollen, heavy-feeling feet in hot weather
Stress and restlessness
Trouble falling asleep
Standing all day at work
General tiredness with no single cause
foot-massage.imageAlt: A towel-wrapped foot resting on a small cushion at the end of a massage table, with a bowl of warm water beside it.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy massage
aromatherapy.short: Massage with natural essential oils, chosen for the effect you are after. Slower and gentler than therapeutic work.
aromatherapy.lede: Aromatherapy is massage using natural oils extracted from flowers, bark, stems, leaves and roots. Applied during a massage they are absorbed through the skin, and the scent is part of the treatment rather than a decoration on top of it.
body: The pace is slower and the pressure gentler than a therapeutic massage. It is the one to book when what you want is calm rather than a specific problem solved.
I hold a certificate in advanced body oil massage and aromatherapy from Athens, issued in January 2011.
goodFor: Stress and mental tiredness
Winding down at the end of the day
Sleeping more soundly
Skin that feels dry after sun and salt water
Aching muscles and stiff joints, gently worked
Wanting the calmest thing on the list
aromatherapy.imageAlt: Amber dropper bottles of essential oil, a sprig of dried lavender and a folded linen cloth on a pale stone surface.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lede: This site collects as little as it can. There is no analytics, no advertising and no tracking of any kind. What follows is the full account of what does happen.

p: The controller of any personal data collected through this website is Konstantinos Fessaras, trading as Mastichari Massage, Mastichari, Kos, Greece.
You can reach me at kosfess@hotmail.com or on +30 6977784790 for anything in this policy, including a request to delete your data.

sections.h: What I receive when you get in touch
p: There is no booking form on this site: bookings are arranged by WhatsApp, phone or email. When you contact me, I receive what you send: usually your name, your phone number or email address, which massage you are interested in, when you would like it, and anything else you choose to write.
This is used for one thing only: to answer you and arrange the appointment. It is not used for marketing, is not shared with anyone, and is not sold.
Before a massage I need to know about pain, injuries, recent surgery or pregnancy, so I will ask you about them. Under the GDPR that is health data, which gets stronger protection.

Please tell me only as much as I need in order to work safely, not your medical history. I process it on the basis of your explicit consent, given by choosing to tell me, and only in order to give the massage safely. It is deleted with the rest of our conversation.
Answering your message and arranging the appointment: steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, GDPR Article 6(1)(b).
Any health details you choose to give: your explicit consent, Article 9(2)(a).
Keeping this website secure and protecting it from automated abuse: legitimate interests, Article 6(1)(f).

sections.h: Where it goes and how long it is kept
p: This website does not collect or store anything you send me. Your messages stay where you sent them: in WhatsApp, on my phone or in my mailbox.
I delete booking conversations once the season they relate to is over, and at the latest twelve months after your last message to me. If you ask me to delete yours sooner, I will do it and confirm.

The website is hosted by Railway, in a European region. WhatsApp messages are handled by WhatsApp (Meta), and my mailbox is a Microsoft Outlook/Hotmail account, so Microsoft processes email as my provider. Both may involve transfer outside the EEA under their own safeguards.
None of these companies is given your data for their own purposes. There are no advertising, analytics or profiling services on this site at all.

The server records the pages that are requested. To stop the site being flooded by automated requests, repeated requests for pages that do not exist are counted against a one-way salted hash of the IP address, which is kept in memory for one minute only.
The plain IP address is not written to the logs, the hash cannot be reversed back into an address, and these records are deleted after 30 days.
This site sets no analytics or advertising cookies, and there is nothing here from any advertising network.

One cookie is strictly necessary: once you answer the cookie notice, it remembers whether you chose "Accept all" or "Necessary only". A second cookie, which remembers the language you chose so you are not sent back to English on the next visit, is set only if you accept it. You are asked on your first visit and can change your answer at any time from "Cookie settings" in the footer. The full list, with how long each one lasts, is in the cookie policy.
You can also delete any of them in your browser at any time. The site will keep working - it will simply forget your language and ask again.

The home and Location pages also embed a live Google Map so you can see exactly where the studio is. That map is loaded directly from Google, not from this site, so once that part of the page loads, Google may set its own cookies and see your IP address under its own privacy policy - this site does not control that. If you would rather not load it, the "View on Google Maps" and "Get directions" links open Google Maps in a new tab instead, and load nothing unless you click them.

The WhatsApp and phone buttons hand you over to the app on your device. If you use the WhatsApp button, your message and number are then handled by WhatsApp under Meta's own privacy policy, not this one.
The same applies to the links to Facebook and X in the footer. Nothing on this site loads content from them in the background - the links do nothing until you click them.
The portrait of Konstantinos and the scanned certificates are genuine photographs and documents.
No photograph of a client appears anywhere on this site.

Under the GDPR you can ask me for a copy of the data I hold about you, ask me to correct it, ask me to delete it, ask me to restrict or stop using it, object to my using it, and ask for it in a portable form. You can withdraw your consent at any time - that does not affect anything done before you withdrew it.
Email kosfess@hotmail.com and I will deal with it within one month. There is no charge.

If you are not satisfied with how I have handled it, you can complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (Αρχή Προστασίας Δεδομένων Προσωπικού Χαρακτήρα), Kifissias 1-3, 115 23 Athens, www.dpa.gr, or to the supervisory authority in your own country.
This site is not aimed at children, and bookings should be made by an adult. Massage for a minor is arranged with a parent or guardian, who must be present.
There are none. No profiling, no automated decision-making. Every booking request is read by me personally.
If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it. The version in force when you contacted me is the one that applies to that booking.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.lede: Short, plain terms for a service given by one person. If anything here is unclear, ask before you book.

p: Massage services are provided personally by Konstantinos Fessaras, trading as Mastichari Massage, Mastichari, Kos, Greece. Contact: kosfess@hotmail.com, +30 6977784790.
There are no employees and no subcontractors. The person who arrives is the person on this website.

sections.h: What this is, and what it is not
p: These are wellness and relaxation massages. They are not medical treatment, physiotherapy, or a diagnosis, and nothing on this website should be read as a promise to cure, treat or prevent any illness or condition.

If you have a health condition, are pregnant, are taking medication that affects bleeding or sensation, or are recovering from an injury or an operation, speak to your doctor first and tell me when you book. In some cases the right answer is that I should not give you a massage, and I will say so.
A booking exists only once I have confirmed the time to you. A request sent by WhatsApp, by email or by phone is a request, not a confirmed appointment.
No deposit is taken and nothing is paid through this website. This site processes no payments of any kind.
Prices are given when you get in touch and are confirmed together with the appointment, before the massage. The price you are quoted at booking is the price you pay.
No price is published on this website. Any figure you may find on an old copy of the previous website is out of date and does not apply.
Plans change on holiday, and there is no cancellation fee. If you cannot make the appointment, tell me as early as you reasonably can so the time can go to someone else.
If I have to cancel - illness or something else outside my control - I will tell you as soon as I know and, where possible, offer another time.
At my own premises in the pedestrian centre of Mastichari, next to Ghitonia. This is the only place the service is given; there are no outcalls.

This is a strictly professional, non-sexual service. Any request, comment or behaviour of a sexual nature ends the session immediately, the full fee remains payable, and no further booking will be accepted.

You keep your underwear on and are covered by a towel throughout, apart from the area being worked on. You can ask me to change the pressure, avoid an area, or stop entirely at any moment, and I will.
If you are not there at the agreed time I will wait and try to reach you. A session that starts late may have to finish at the time it was due to end, because of the appointment after it.
I work with reasonable skill and care, in line with my training and certification. I am not liable for a reaction or an injury arising from a condition you did not tell me about when I asked.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lede: This is the full list of cookies this site can set, why, and how long each one lasts. You choose which of them are set, and you can change your mind at any time.

p: When you first visit, a small notice asks you to accept all cookies or necessary only. Necessary only means the site keeps just one cookie, the one that records that answer; accepting all also lets it remember the language you picked.
You can change your mind at any time - open "Cookie settings" in the footer of any page, on any language, to see the notice again and pick a different answer.

cookieConsent - remembers whether you chose "Accept all" or "Necessary only", so the notice does not reappear on every page. It is set when you answer the notice, and the same answer is also kept in your browser's local storage. Lasts twelve months.
It is strictly necessary for the cookie notice itself to work, so the GDPR and Greek law do not require your consent for it. The server itself sets no cookies.

sections.h: Cookie set only if you accept
p: lang - remembers the language you chose (English, Greek, German and so on) so the site does not send you back to English on your next visit. Lasts twelve months.

If you choose "Necessary only", this cookie is not set, and any copy already on your device is deleted the next time a page loads. The site still works - it simply asks your browser for its preferred language and falls back to English.

sections.h: What this site does not set
p: No analytics, no advertising, no social-media pixels, no cross-site tracking of any kind. Nothing on this site measures how many people visit it or where they came from.

The home and Location pages embed a live Google Map so you can see exactly where the studio is. That map is loaded directly from Google, not from this site, so once it loads, Google may set its own cookies under its own privacy policy - this site does not control that and receives nothing from it.
If you would rather not load it, the "View on Google Maps" and "Get directions" links open Google Maps in a new tab instead, and nothing loads unless you click them.

Every browser lets you see and delete cookies, and block them from being set again, in its settings. Doing that here will simply reset your choice and, if you had accepted, forget your saved language.
